build_transformer_encoder_layer: build a TransformerEncoderLayer with self-attention and feed-forward network for sequence encoding
build_transformer_decoder_layer: build a TransformerDecoderLayer with self-attention, encoder attention, and feed-forward network
run_encoder_forward_pass: run a forward pass through TransformerEncoderLayer with input tensor and optional attention mask
run_decoder_forward_pass: run a forward pass through TransformerDecoderLayer with encoder output and incremental state support
review_residual_connection: review the residual_connection method that adds input to residual in both encoder and decoder layers
